description: The Merchant API overview omitted the variant grouping rule, and the earlier field-page fetch exceeded the host response limit. A first-party API definition offers a specific way to check whether the failed sample can be reopened. If it establishes an actionable rule, the next deliverable is a tested preflight example an operator can show a merchant. The feedback feed still has five unclassified sources and ten unexplained skips, so demand remains unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 verified available and no verified revenue. The count-only acceptance check can proceed independently without spending.
